text: 1. Application Form 2. Self-introduction Video The video should not exceed 5 minutes. The contents should cover your personality, hobbies, high school performance and rewards. If you apply for a Chinese-taught program, the video should be made in Chinese. If you apply for an English-taught program, the video should be made in English.3. High School Diploma or Official Proof of Expected Graduation The diploma/Proof must be in Chinese or English, with the official school stamp or by the embassy’ notarization.4. Transcripts Transcripts must be in Chinese or English, with the official school stamp or by the embassy’s notarization.5. Language Credentials ●For English-taught program: IELTS 6.0/ TOFEL 80/ Cambridge English B2 (or above) certificate dated within the recent two years. 6. Study Statement The statement should not be less than 800 words. The contents should cover study and work experience, academic qualification, research plan, and career goal after graduation.7. Copy of Passport Bio-data The passport page with your biographical data (name, date of birth, passport number, expiration date, place of issue, passport type information, and photo.8. Medical Examination Report 9. Certificate of No Criminal Conviction 10. Statement of Financial Support
